name: L10 LSAA Vienna source-disjoint address-door panel
question: Does LSAA admit a provider- and city-disjoint panel with an OSM address credential, exactly one official door instance, and enough image quality to test the frozen portal-private witness without pixel-selected examples?

providers.dataset: Large Scale Architectural Asset Dataset (LSAA), CC BY-NC-SA 4.0

selection.pixel_blind: Selection may read only LSAA CSV/JSON metadata, current OSM way tags, and prior source identities. It may not request or decode a facade, door crop, panorama, thumbnail, OCR output, portal output, or model score.
selection.negative_control: Within each split, rotate the next distinct true house number onto the current facade as a deterministic counterfactual mission. Any emitted binding is wrong for that control.

claim_boundary: A source admission pass establishes only a pixel-blind, provider- and city-disjoint candidate panel. OSM address tags and LSAA door boxes are not visible-text truth, runtime model inputs, portal ownership, public access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, user benefit, or safety evidence.
